established: A narrow candidate view is not a valid correction for these two families with the frozen benchmark model.
Application launch reaches 0.80 on the unchanged path and is not the dominant weakness on this holdout.
Software management remains the dominant measured weakness on the unchanged and facade paths.
Reducing median schema bytes by roughly 86 to 88 percent can reduce selection quality.
The product remained unchanged because the facade was disabled throughout the experiment.
not_established: This two-family holdout does not measure the other 362 registered tools.
This result does not identify which non-pruning software disambiguation design will generalize.
No business execution or safety claim is inferred from a selection-only campaign.
